title: The Alien Life
speaker: Ben Philips
summary: Peter is writing to elect exiles, people scattered across five Roman provinces who had changed so much that their own culture pushed them to the edges. They were called rebellious for the things they had stopped doing. Week 2 walks through what Peter says to people like that. Crave the pure spiritual milk and put away what blocks your appetite for it. Come to the Living Stone and be built into a spiritual house. Learn the name you were given before you were asked for anything. And when suffering comes, follow the hypogrammos, the tracing pattern, of the One who committed no sin, returned no threats, bore our sins in his body on the tree, and brought us home to the Shepherd and Overseer of our souls.
subtitle: 1 and 2 Peter Week 2
